desc: A bright living room scene shows a man and a young girl lying on a carpet, smiling and drawing together on paper. The man wears glasses and a dark green shirt, while the girl wears a pink top with bows in her hair. In the background, a woman sits on a blue sofa using her phone. Colorful cushions, stacked books, plants, large windows, and white brick walls complete the cozy setting.

The image shows three coworkers gathered around a laptop at a table in a bright, modern office. A smiling woman in a white blouse sits on the left, a man in a gray shirt sits in the center using the laptop, and another woman in a blue top stands behind them. Large windows reveal a blurred cityscape in the background, with a small plant on the right side of the table.

A wedding reception is taking place around a decorated dining table. A bride in a tiara and strapless white dress sits on the right beside a young boy in a suit, who is blowing out candles on a small red cake. A groom in a black suit and patterned vest sits nearby, with several guests gathered behind them. The table is covered with flowers, wine glasses, drinks, and cutlery, while warm draped lighting creates a festive atmosphere.
